result.one_liner: Consensus is an AI-powered academic search engine that answers research questions with evidence-backed summaries drawn from 200+ million peer-reviewed papers.

evidence.quote: Calls are $0.05 each beyond the credits included in your plan (500 on Pro/Team/Enterprise, 2,000 on Deep) plus 1 additional credit per 100 papers.

result.notes: consensus.app (AI research search engine) supports both OAuth2 (authorization_code + PKCE + dynamic client registration, confirmed via its own .well-known/oauth-authorization-server metadata) and API-key auth ("Create API key" flow on home/api page). API credits are tied to paid subscription tiers (Pro/Team/Enterprise/Deep) with pay-per-call overage ($0.05/call) — no documented free dev tier with included credits, so access is paid_plan rather than self-serve-free. Official hosted MCP server exists at mcp.consensus.app/mcp using the same OAuth2 bridge. Do not confuse with goconsensus.com ("Consensus" sales-enablement/proposal software), a different company that also has its own OAuth guide and MCP server — that is not this app. docs.consensus.app itself returned 403 (Cloudflare challenge) on direct fetch, so some claims rely on consensus.app marketing pages and third-party summaries rather than the primary docs site; confidence lowered accordingly.
